scope: Optional authenticated, independently reviewed, encrypted JDBC approval with single-use grant consumption and monotonic witness confirmation; not a full enterprise workflow or exactly-once business execution guarantee

fullReactor.skipReason: Optional real-provider test is not enabled

documentation.notes: Three existing unrelated anchor-link INFO messages; no warnings in successful strict build

capabilities.identity: Mandatory AuthenticatedActor from fixed identity policy; exact requester context and token binding; no stored bearer credentials
capabilities.humanReview: Different principal, same tenant and identity profile, fixed per-tool permissions, current trusted issuer human/MFA assertions
capabilities.action: Core ActionIdentity recomputed; session/action/tool/effective parameters/policy/effect rule/business intent bound; full reviewed request and private view capability checked
capabilities.storage: AES-256-GCM with catalog/config/request/revision/key/previous hash AAD; HMAC-sealed reviewed catalog; fixed host key provider and explicit deployment initialization
capabilities.witness: Mandatory independent AuditWitness; current or exactly one pending primary suffix; bounded encrypted lineage proves original commit when another worker has advanced
capabilities.delivery: VIEW confirmed before full request delivery; CONSUMED confirmed before allow response; online identity and deadline rechecked after confirmation
capabilities.replay: Consumed approval never becomes approved again; lost response or process exit can lose an unused grant but cannot automatically retry it
capabilities.bodyRetention: Current request body removed in denied/consumed/cancelled/expired states; explicit trusted expiry sweep handles unvisited expired pending/approved rows; tombstone/history remain
capabilities.limits: Configured total retained rows including tombstones, request <=64 KiB, state ciphertext <=128 KiB, views <=16, event/lineage bounds, per-resolver finite waiting threads/queue and SQL deadlines

checks: Full request review and single use
Actual decrypted terminal state no longer contains request body
Self approval, cross tenant, wrong role and service reviewer denied
Different reviewer or refreshed reviewer token cannot reuse view proof
Changed request/action/private claim denied
New view invalidates old view, metadata receipt preserves view version
Cancellation/expiry/clock rollback/requester revocation
Concurrent store consumption returns only one allow
Valid old primary backup and missing witness fail closed
Witness outage after decision can recover, lost consumption cannot return allow
Cipher and catalog substitution rejected
Delayed publisher verifies its lineage after another instance advances
Expiry sweep clears bodies and retains tombstones
Payload/retained record capacity
Policy effect rule and expected business state bound
Revocation during view or consumption confirmation suppresses delivery
Actual IdentitySession and core approval to real HTTP backend
Viewed parameters equal actual business request
Independent human denial produces zero backend requests
SDK timeout and late approval produce zero backend requests
Per-resolver capacity, cancellation slot reuse and close
Two independent SDK JVMs share primary/witness H2 and compete for same approval; backend request count 1
Kill worker after CONSUMED DB commit before witness advance; next JVM confirms durable consumption and refuses; backend request count 0
AEAD integrity/nonces and old audit behavior
Direct legacy JCA AES-GCM nonce prefix/AAD compatibility in both directions after extraction to shared core storage primitive

notVerifiedOrNotImplemented: No external enterprise IdP, actual MFA browser login, CSRF or approval workbench deployed
Actor assurance is issuer assertion; distinct subjects do not prove distinct natural persons
No quorum approval or automatic revocation of previously issued human decisions
No resume of original JVM session/business after restart and no arbitrary workflow engine
No public cross-tenant admin or persistent reviewer queue API
H2 logical primary/witness run on same local test server, not separate production trust domains or database-server restart certification
No production database dialect, connection-pool wait, availability or load certification
Cross-node and restarted absolute deadlines still require trusted UTC; monotonic actor time is per live instance, not an independent trusted time service
SQL deadline does not bound an improperly configured DataSource connection wait
Resolver limits are per instance; host must bound and close instances
No automatic tombstone archival, catalog/config migration or key rotation operations
Terminal body removal does not crypto-erase backups, WAL or old ciphertext
Approval consumption and remote business are not one atomic transaction; unknown business results require durable effect reconciliation
Supply-chain tool version approval and credential isolation still pending
